Dear Miss Yonge	
The [cheque](../others.html#160) for £200 was sent you last night.

My clerk reminded that former remittances were so made.

The monthly payments will be sent the same way.
[I ](../persons.html#939)am going to have the second [chapter](../others.html#177) as the first set up in type. I will venture to go over it and make any suggestions that strike me.

Yours ever faithfully
A.

Macmillan
